title: Delegate Permissions
description: Sarah delegates specific, scoped permissions to her agent. The agent can only access what Sarah explicitly allows.

steps.label: Select Agent
steps.description: Sarah selects her research agent for delegation

steps.label: Choose Scopes
steps.description: Sarah selects the specific permissions to delegate

steps.label: Create Delegation
steps.description: Delegation is recorded; agent receives scoped L3 token

steps.label: Agent Token Updated
steps.description: Agent's JWT is enriched with the delegated permissions
